channel.title: CT Soccer News
channel.description: Season storylines and match results for Connecticut's real professional and semi-pro soccer clubs.

item.title: New: Coaching Clinics directory with real CJSA/US Soccer course pricing
item.description: Browse every Grassroots-through-B-License course CJSA and US Soccer offer in Connecticut, filterable by tier and ranked by value.

item.title: Live results now tracking for Hartford Athletic, AC Connecticut, and CT Rush
item.description: CT Soccer now pulls real results and upcoming fixtures automatically for all three USL-affiliated clubs, refreshing every five minutes.

item.title: Hartford Athletic draw 1–1 with Indy Eleven
item.description: Jordan Scarlett's second-half equalizer salvaged a point on the road, part of a stretch that has seen Hartford draw four of its last six USL Championship matches.

item.title: CT United FC beats Orlando City B 4–2, fourth win in five matches
item.description: A four-goal outing continued CT United's strong summer stretch in MLS Next Pro, pushing the club's win percentage well above .500 for the season.

item.title: New Haven United FC wins the NPSL North Atlantic Conference outright
item.description: In just its second season, New Haven United finished 1st in the North Atlantic Conference before advancing to the NPSL National Semifinal — the deepest playoff run by a Connecticut NPSL club.

item.title: USL League Two regular season wraps up for AC Connecticut and CT Rush
item.description: Both Connecticut clubs closed out the Northeast Division regular season — CT Rush finished 8th, AC Connecticut 9th. CT Rush's debut USL2 season is now complete.

item.title: CT United FC opens inaugural season with a 3–1 road win over FC Cincinnati 2
item.description: Connecticut's first-ever MLS Next Pro club made history in its debut match, the first step in a season that has since seen the club climb to a winning record.
